raw_text: The reorganisation of Russian private military operations in Africa is accelerating following Prigozhin's death. In Libya, Wagner fighters previously stationed in Syria are being repositioned around critical oil infrastructure in the Sirte Basin. The move suggests Moscow intends to maintain and expand its influence over Libyan energy assets through the newly created Africa Corps structure, which reports directly to the Russian Ministry of Defence rather than operating as an independent entity.
clean_text: Russian PMC reorganization accelerating post-Prigozhin. Wagner fighters from Syria repositioning around Sirte Basin oil infrastructure. Africa Corps now reports directly to Russian Ministry of Defence.
